question: In which of the following Indian states is the Sundarbans Biosphere Reserve located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Sundarbans Biosphere Reserve** is located in the state of **West Bengal**, India. It is part of the Sundarbans delta region, which is shared between India and Bangladesh.
 
• The Sundarbans is the **largest mangrove forest** in the world and is recognized as a UNESCO **World Heritage Site** for its ecological significance.
 
• The reserve is home to **Royal Bengal Tigers**, saltwater crocodiles, and a variety of bird species, making it an important area for biodiversity conservation.
 
• The Sundarbans Biosphere Reserve covers an area of approximately **9,630 square kilometers**, including mangrove forests, mudflats, and tidal waterways.
 
• The region plays a vital role in protecting coastal areas from erosion and acts as a natural barrier against cyclones and tidal surges.
